name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.

Your privacy, locked down: messages from anyone who is not your customer - family, friends, groups, unknown numbers - now never leave your computer. ASVA only ever receives a message when your own customer replies about a payment.

Smoother updates: the "ASVA cannot be closed" message is fixed. ASVA closes its background parts on its own and installs quietly - nothing to close by hand.

A new Today home: money that came in, who to chase (biggest first, with each customer's phone and one-tap Call), cash likely this week, and how many days your money is stuck. Honest counts, do-not-chase customers stay off the list, add a missing number right there, and the page recovers on its own instead of going blank.

Smarter assistant: it pitches a new lead once and then stays quiet, and hands over to you the moment someone is interested, so it never talks over your conversation.

Also: trade-based due dates (electricals 60 days) when Tally has none, a fairer reliability score where one late bill among many paid does not drag a customer down, a money-in alert when a customer says they paid, and your WhatsApp login surviving updates.
